Commentary.Commentary: That is it from the coverage of this game. Virat Kohli gets the trophy and the entire Indian team has a round in the car won by Jasprit Bumrah, with MS Dhoni behind the wheels. A complete domination from the visitors in both the Tests and ODIs. The hosts will have to sort out their plans and hope for a win in the one-off T20I which will be played at the same venue on the 6th of September at 1900 local (1330 GMT). Do join us for that. Till then, take care and cheers!

Virat Kohli starts by saying that it's always good to win the series 5-0. Praises his side for the way they stood up. Continues saying that it has been a clinical show from his side and this momentum might help them against the Aussies in their upcoming series. Loves visiting Sri Lanka and feels that the people here are really kind and something that draws his attention is the way they show hospitality. Ends by saying that he would want to come here soon.

Man of the Series, Jasprit Bumrah is delighted with the way he has bowled. Says it's his dream to play the longest format of the game. Further says he got a good rest before this series which has helped him come out with a bang. Credits Malinga by stating that he has learnt a lot from the Lankan veteran as both of them play for the same team in the Indian T20 League.

Upul Tharanga says it is a difficult phase for them. Credits India for their dominating performance in the series. Mentions they lost too many wickets early and 260-270 would have been a good score. Admits they have to improve in all the three departments. Reckons the batting was very disappointing and a lot of work has to be done. Ends by saying that injuries are a big concern for them but accepts that they were not at their best.

Man of the Match, Bhuvneshwar Kumar says he knew he was not among the wickets but is happy to get a fifer today. Admits they wanted to bowl more slower balls and that was their strategy. Reckons that there was nothing to prove, he just wanted to do well for his team.

Sir Lanka on the other hand, started off really well with Malinga and Fernando bagging a wicket each but were not supported well by the rest. The spinners could not get a lot of assistance from the wicket and hence couldn't build the pressure which allowed the Indian batsmen to run away with the game. They have a lot of soul searching to do as with each game passing by they have been handed drubbing after drubbing which for sure must have dented the team's morale. This also happens to be the first instance where the hosts have been whitewashed in their own den, an unwanted record! Stay tuned for the presentation coming up in a while...

Another stunning performance from team India has seen them end the series on a high. They have bossed the game and Virat Kohli, their captain has once again taken his side over the line with an unbeaten ton. With this hundred, he is only behind Sachin Tendulkar in the list of most hundreds in ODIs. Summary - India did lose two early wickets but Kohli decided to anchor the chase. He first with Pandey, then with Jadhav constructed two useful partnerships and ensured there were no further hiccups. In the end, the visitors gunned down the target with utmost ease.

That is it! India have cruised to victory! They have completed a whitewash. Tossed up on off, Kohli drives it past the diving bowler and takes the single. INDIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS WITH 21 BALLS TO SPARE!
No, he cannot finish it off! Shorter outside off, Dhoni cuts it through covers for a run. Scores are level now.
MS Dhoni walks in next. Can he hit the winning runs? India just need 2...

OUT! Hasaranga gets a wicket. Too late for Sri Lanka though. Flatter outside off, Kedar Jadhav gets a faint edge to the keeper who takes it and appeals. The umpire raises his finger and Kedar has to depart. He walks back dejected as he fails to take his team over the line. India are just two runs away.
Wanidu Hasaranga comes back into the attack.
Tosses it up on off, Jadhav pushes it down to long off for a run. Two runs needed now.
Flatter on off, Kedar pushes it back to the bowler.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Pulls the short ball through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Drags his length back on the stumps, Kohli's eyes lit up and he goes over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter in length on off, Kedar punches it off the back foot through mid on for a run.
Works it against the spin through square leg for a run.
Fires it down the leg side, Kedar flicks it towards short fine leg for a run.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it through covers for a run.
100-run stand between Kohli and Jadhav!
Drags his length back outside off, Kedar cuts it through point for a run.
Sprays it on the pads, Kohli gets it fine down the leg side for a run.
A leg spinner on leg stump, Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket.
Quicker on off, Jadhav defends it watchfully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags his length back on off, Jadhav pushes it to covers.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
Makes room and comes down the track and jams it out through cover-point for a single.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli drives it through covers for a run.
Works it with the spin towards square leg.
Shorter in length outside off, Jadhav plays it towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
30th ODI century for Kohli, 19th while chasing!

Hundred for Kohli! A captain's knock to say the least. He has been brilliant and has shouldered the responsibility. A true run-machine and surely the best ODI batsman going around. This is his 19th in chases, this lad loves chasing doesn't he? Just a raise of his arms as the whole Indian dressing room is up on its feet. Coming to the ball, quicker on off, Virat plays it towards point to get to the other end.
Flatter outside off, Jadhav punches it through the off side for a run.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Sees a flighted ball, comes down the track and hits it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary. Akila has had the better of Kedar but now he is taking the attack to him.
Akila Dananjaya is back on.
Full toss on leg stump, Kedar drives it down to long on. He did not want to take a single there but he had to. He slaps his thigh as he ran for it. He wanted Kohli to be on strike there.
Slower through the air on off, Jadhav defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot. They pick up a single.
Floats it on off, Virat drives it to covers.
Shorter in length outside off, Kohli guides it to point.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side. Kohli misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
Drags his length back on legs stump, Jadhav pulls it through the leg side for a run.
Milinda Siriwardana comes into the attack.
Bouncer on off, Jadhav pulls it through square leg for a run.
Full toss on off, Jadhav drives it to mid off.
Shorter in length on middle, Kohli pulls it through square leg for a run.
Second ODI fifty for Kedar Jadhav.
Fifty for Kedar! He acknowledges the applauds from his teammates. A good way to get back in form for him. Slower ball outside off, Kedar guides it down to third man for a run.
A low full toss on off, Kedar pushes it to mid off.
Bowls it on the pads, Kohli flicks it through square leg for a run.
Eases it down to long off for a run. He moves onto 96.
Shorter in length outside off, Jadhav pushes it through covers for a run.
Plays the sweep shot towards short fine leg for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, Virat punches it back to the bowler.
Plays it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length on off, Jadhav defends it off the front foot.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket keeper.

FOUR! That piece of fielding sums up Sri Lanka's day! Fuller on the pads, Jadhav flicks it perfectly in the gap between fine leg and deep backward square leg. The latter runs to his right and puts in a dive but makes contact with the rope while touching the ball.
Slower bouncer outside off, Kedar opts not to play at it.
A low full toss on the leg stump, Kohli flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Shorter on middle, Kedar was waiting for it. He pulls it through square leg for a run.
Wide! Malinga hits the deck hard, bowls it outside off. Jadhav just lets it sail over his head. Too high and it's rightly called as a wide.
Stays back and clips it through square leg to retain strike.
FOUR! Swept away! Tossed up wider outside off, Jadhav gets down on one knee and sweeps it off the middle of the bat towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Looks to loft it inside out over cover but the ball turns away to beat him.
Leans forward and bunts it back to Pushpakumara.
1000 ODI runs for Virat Kohli in 2017! With an average of 90, that's some feat!
Eases this full ball down to long on for an easy single.
Floats it up on the stumps, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Drinks. India are cruising to victory. Kohli is only 8 runs away from his 30th ODI ton and is well supported by Kedar.
FOUR! One short ball too many! Kedar was expecting that. Malinga bangs it short. Jadhav shuffles across and pulls it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
A well-directed bouncer but that was equally well played by Kohli who pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Change of pace outside off, Kohli defends it to point.
Off pace delivery on middle, Kohli flicks it through square leg for a brace. He is into the 90s now.
Slower yorker outside off, Jadhav guides it down to third man for a run.
Bangs it short on leg stump. Jadhav ducks under it.
He was warming up and now Lasith Malinga is brought into the attack.
Once again fuller outside off, Kohli caresses it through the covers for a couple. This time Jadhav is racing back for the second.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Flatter on off, Kohli guides it towards short third man and wants the single but is sent back by Jadhav. Kohli wanted a run there, he was not happy when Jadhav sent him back.
FOUR! He is just milking the bowlers. Floats it on off, Kohli leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Very full on off, Kohli drives it back to the bowler.
Drags his length back outside off, Jadhav cuts it through the off side for a run.
Shortish again outside off, bounces a bit more. Kohli tries to upper cut it but gets beaten.
Short outside off, Kohli cuts it to the man at point.
50-run stand comes up between Kohli and Jadhav!
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Kedar pulls it through square leg for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Kohli drives it down to long off for a run.
Good length outside off, Jadhav guides it towards gully. The fielder there makes a good diving half-stop but the batsman take a single.
Fuller outside off, Kohli times it through covers for a run.
Malinga is seen warming up.
Loops it up outside off, pushed into the cover region. 9 came from the over!

FOUR! Half-tracker and it was asking to be hit! Jadhav obliges as he camps back and pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket. Second boundary of the over and things going all too easy for the Men in Blue.
Full on off, blazed towards sweeper cover for one.

FOUR! Beats the man at short third man this time! Short and outside off, turning further away. Kohli crouches low and plays it really late. Dabs it almost off the keeper's glove and beats the dive of the fielder at short third man to pick up a boundary.
Allows the ball to turn away and cuts it late towards short third man.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched straight towards the extra cover fielder.
A double change! Wanidu Hasaranga comes back into the attack. Tharanga is playing all his cards here.
Bangs in a short ball, Jadhav initially winds up for the pull but then decides to show some respect to the bowler. He lets it sail over him to the keeper.
Slants it across the batsman, the little man shoulders his arms.
Chopped! Length ball, delivered wide outside off, Kedar looks to dab and run but gets a bottom edge which evades the stumps and rolls on the bounce to Dickwella behind.
How easy it is for Kohli? Vishwa Fernando comes steaming in, lands it on a length outside off. What does Virat do? He stands tall and uses the pace to run it down to third man. Gets to the other end.
A bit short and slanted once again outside off. Kedar keeps his bat skywards and plays the upper cut towards third man which lands short of the man there. Another single taken.
Fernando comes from over the wicket and slants it away from the Indian skipper. Easily dabbed down to third man for a single.
Time for some pace now! Vishwa Fernando is back into the attack. He needs to pick a wicket here. 77 more needed from 18 overs.

FOUR! Nailed it! Floats it up on the stumps, Jadhav kneels down and brings out the powerful slog sweep. Hits it off the middle of the bat and dumps it towards deep mid-wicket to end the over with a boundary. Kohli likes it.
Gets across a touch and keeps it out.
Flat outside off, KJ goes back to cut but is beaten all ends up.
Quicker through the air, it's dropped short. Jadhav knows there is no one in the deep and hence chips it over mid-wicket to get a double.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Flighted delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
An appeal for an LBW! Pushes it quicker through the air, Kohli looks to broom it away but misses it. Gets hit on the pads and an appeal is made. The umpire turns it down as it was going down leg.
Turning in from a length, clipped with the turn through square leg. Another brace taken.
Beaten! Straighter one on off, Kohli tries to thwack it through the line bu the ball skids through and he gets beaten.

Once again excellent fielding in the deep! A bit too full around leg, Kohli clears his front leg and whips it with timing towards deep mid-wicket. Pushpakumara in the deep, hares to his left to make a sliding stop. Two taken.

Good fielding in the deep! Quicker through the air, wide outside off, Jadhav once again sits back and dabs it down to third man. Fernando in the deep, goes sprinting to his left, shows some soccer skills to save a run for his side.
Turning away from a length, it's well outside off. Jadhav goes back and guides it behind point to collect a brace.
A bit fuller outside off, Kohli looks to drive. Gets it off the outer half but finds the man at point.
Lunges forward and works it towards the right of the bowler.
Flattish through the air, Kohli punches it towards the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on off, eased through covers for one.
Flatter on the stumps, defended well.

Good running between the wickets! If Kohli is at the other end, it's ought that he'll make you run. I remember a game which happened earlier this year against England where these two were batting together. Jadhav was the Man of the Match then and he said, it's not easy to bat with Virat Kohli, he makes you run hard. Coming to the ball, around off, turning in, clipped deftly down to fine leg. Malinga gives it a chase but they run three.
Too full outside off, driven straight to the fielder at short extra cover.
Goes back and tucks it towards short leg.
Flatter on middle, punched down to long on for a single.

In the air... falls short! Bowls a leg-spinner, it's a bit too short. Jadhav rocks back and looks to pull. Mistimes it towards long on and the shouts of CATCH IT! go up! Luckily, for Kedar the ball falls short of the man at long on. A single taken.
Floats it up outside off, turning in. Virat goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker outside off, Jadhav defends it to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, Jadhav defends it back foot.
Floats it on off, Kedar defends it solidly.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Slower through the air on off, Kohli drives it through mid off for a run.
FOUR! Quicker outside off, Jadhav waits and cuts it behind point for a boundary.

Tosses it up on off, Jadhav defends it towards covers and sets off for a run. The fielder rushes in and makes a wild throw at the striker's end. They complete one. The keeper is not able to collect the ball and they get another overthrow.
Plays a sweep shot to the full toss on leg stump which goes straight to the short fine fielder.
Flatter on off, Jadhav defends it off the back foot.
Very full on the stumps, Jadhav keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it through the off side for a run.
Very, very slow through the air on middle, turns away. Jadhav does well to defend it.
Flights it on off, Kohli drives it through mid off for a run.
Slower through the air on off, turning away. Jadhav defends it towards covers and takes a run.
Fires it down the leg side, Jadhav sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Kedar Jadhav is the new man in. As soon as he stepped in, Kohli walks towards him to share something. What's the message from the skipper?

OUT! A much-needed breakthrough for Sri Lanka. Pushpakumara gets Manish Pandey. Bowls it slower on middle, turning away. Pandey goes for the slog sweep as there is no one in the deep mid-wicket area. He gets a top edge as the ball is too full and it goes straight up in the air towards short mid-wicket. Upul Tharanga stationed there settles himself under it and takes it easily. The 99-run stand has been broken. An opening for Sri Lanka? They would surely hope so.
Driven towards the mid-off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bowls a flipper on middle, Pandey fails to read it. He first goes for the cut but then adjusts well and defends it.
Tosses it up on off, Pandey tries to go over the off side but gets it off the inner half down to long on for a couple.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, Kohli punches it off the back foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wanidu Hasaranga comes on to bowl.
Shorter on the stumps, Virat punches it to long on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Pandey punches it through the off side for a run.
Floats it on off, Pandey blocks it.
Loopy ball on off, Pandey lunges forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

NOT OUT! Floats it on off, turns away from the batsman. Pandey lunges forward to block but gets beaten. The keeper collects the ball and whips the bails off. He appeals and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that his foot was inside the crease. Manish Pandey survives.
A stumping appeal against Manish Pandey is referred upstairs. The batsman looks safe though...
FOUR! Third of the over! Floats it on off, Kohli drives it over cover-point and into the fence for a boundary. Siriwardana's first over has cost Sri Lanka 14 runs.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli defends it off the front foot.
Worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! Shorter in length on middle, Kohli whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
45th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli.

FOUR! POOR STUFF! Shorter and on the stumps, Kohli gets that bottom hand into play and bludgeons it through mid on for a boundary. The master of run chases has also brought his fifty up. Can he go on to convert this into a big one? Well, by the looks of things it seems so.
Milinda Siriwardana comes into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball on off, goes on with the arm. Pandey tries to defend but gets an inside edge through short fine leg for a couple.

NOT OUT! Shorter in length on off, Kohli punches it towards covers and sets off for a run. The fielder there gets to the ball and fires a flat quick throw to the keeper who whips the bails off in a flash. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that the dive from Manish Pandey has helped him make the crease with ease. A direct hit was needed. One run added to the total.
A referral for a run out has been sent upstairs. Not a lot of excitement from the Sri Lankans.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli drives it towards covers.
Shorter in length outside off, Kohli cuts it to point.
Angles it on the pads, Pandey flicks it through square leg for a run.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off for a run.
Drags his length back on leg stump. Pandey pulls it to short fine leg. He will be dissapointed he did not put that away.
Slower through the air on off, Manish defends it solidly.
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Pandey drives it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Kohli plays it down to fine leg for a run.
Drives it to the cover fielder.
FOUR! NAILED IT! Comes down the track and takes it on the full. Pandey whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 100 up for India. They need another 139 now.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Drags his length back on off, Kohli camps back and goes for the pull but is early into the shot. He gets a bottom edge down to long on for a run.
Plays it against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it on off, Kohli drives it down to long on for a run.
Flighted outside off, turning back in. Pandey guides it to point.
Slower through the air, Pandey plays it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter in length outside off, Kohli guides it through short third man and the batsmen run three. Excellent running by the two.
Works it with the spin towards square leg.
Off spinner this time outside off, turning back in. Kohli defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli leans into it and drives it through covers for two.
Floats it on off, Pandey gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to defend.
Loopy ball on middle, turning away. Pandey goes to sweep but misses and the ball hits him high on the pads.
Fires it down the pads, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! DEFT! Quicker through the air this time. Kohli waits for it and guides it through short third man for a boundary.
Slower through the air on off, turning away. Pandey tries to drive it but gets an outside edge through covers for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Pandey defends it off the front foot.
Malinda Pushpakumara is now into the attack.

Time for Drinks. So, after losing the wickets of Ajinkya Rahane and Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli and Manish Pandey have made sure there are no further hiccups. India still need another 157 runs and Sri Lanka would hope for a wicket or two after the break. Akila Dananjaya is looking dangerous and if he manages to get a opening here, the visitors will start to feel the heat...
Good fielding! A bit flat and short outside off, Kohli crouches low, reaches out to that one to slap it behind point. Malinga in the deep does well to stop it with his left boot. Two runs picked up.
Once again sharp turn. Pitches it outside off, it turns in as Kohli just about manages to flick it towards the man at square leg. The fielder fumbles but the batsmen don't cross.
Bowls the wrong 'un this time, Kohli lunges forward and defends it off the inner half towards the on side.
Beaten! Dananjaya bowls a leg-spinner around middle, Kohli goes back to defend but the ball turns away to nearly take the outside edge.
Down the leg side, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Loopy full toss, dipping in, Manish hits it straight towards the fielder at short mid-wicket.
50-run stand between Kohli and Pandey!
Outside off, tapped towards the point region for a single.

Sloppy from Malinga! Pandey pushes it towards Malinga at mid on and takes him on. The Lankan veteran, charges towards the ball but at the last moment he takes his eyes off it, allowing the batsmen to take a brace.
In the air... safe! Mathews sticks to the slower ones and angles it in this time. Kohli is early into his flick as the ball goes uppishly towards mid-wicket. He picks up a single.
Giving no pace at all. Kohli taps it besides the pitch, looks to cross but Mathews himself runs to the ball to deny him.
Change of pace from Angelo. It's pushed towards the cover region.
Length delivery outside off, Manish Pandey cracks it over a leaping backward point fielder for a single.
Comes a bit forward to work it with the spin towards short mid-wicket. Good bowling from Akila.
Leading edge but safe... Tosses it up outside off, Kohli closes the face of the bat early but the ball doesn't turn. Goes off the leading edge but falls well short of Dananjaya.
Tosses up around off, worked with the spin towards short mid-wicket.
This time Pandey reaches out and eases it down to long on for one.
Takes a stride forward and milks it down to long on for a single.
Floats it up outside off, turning in, Kohli goes back and tucks it towards backward square leg for a comfortable couple.
Slower ball, full on middle. VK walks across and clips it towards wide mid on for a quick single to keep strike.
Gets behind the line and defends it back down the pitch.
Slower bouncer outside off, Kohli stands in the crease and lets it sail over to the keeper. He immediately looks at the square leg umpire but it's not called as a wide.
Angles it in on the pads, clipped behind square eon the leg side for a single.
Comes down the track and touch and pushes it towards mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards cover for a single.
The batsman drives the ball straight back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, Virat drives it to long on for a run.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Shorter in length on middle, Kohli pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
A full toss on off, dipping on the batsman. Pandey drives it down to long on for a run.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on the pads, Pandey flicks it through square leg for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Pandey drives it to mid off.
Just ahead of a length on middle, Kohli walks across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball outside off, Manish guides it down to third man for a run.
Short ball on off, Pandey pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Angles it onto the pads, Kohli flicks it through the leg side for a run.
Angelo Mathews is into the attack. He was handy with the ball in the last game and Sri Lanka will hope for the same.
Slower through the air, does not turn a lot. Pandey plays it to mid-wicket.
Drags his length back on middle, Kohli pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Works it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Shorter outside off, Kohli goes on the back foot and punches it down to long on for a run.
Full on the stumps, Pandey drives it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on off, turning back in. Pandey tucks it to mid-wicket.
Bowling change as well. Just like India did, Sri Lanka have brought their go-to spinner, Akila Dananjaya into the attack.
Powerplay 2 signaled by the umpire. 4 fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Makes great use of the Free Hit. Fernando serves a full delivery outside off, Kohli bludgeons it down the ground for a boundary.
Free Hit coming up...
NO BALL! Slower ball down the leg side. Kohli misses the flick. Fernando has overstepped and the umpire signals a no ball. A Free Hit coming up.
FOUR! What a shot! Shot of the day. Not that full outside off, Kohli walks ahead and drives it through covers for a boundary. That was timed to perfection.
Length ball on middle, Kohli flicks it uppishly through the vacant mid-wicket area for a couple.
Slower ball outside off, does not quite bounce as Kohli expected. Virat goes for the pull but misses.
Shorter in length outside off, Pandey taps it in front of covers and takes a run.
Lands it on a length around off, Kohli shuffles across and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Slower bouncer on off, Kohli pulls it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there runs to his right and makes a good diving stop. A single taken by the batsmen.
Length outside off, Pandey guides it down to third man for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Shorter in length on off, Pandey hits it past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lands it on a length on off, Pandey defends it off the front foot.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Angles it on the pads, Pandey fails to flick it but it goes off the pads and down to the fine leg fence.
Length ball outside off, Pandey feels for it but gets beaten.
Manish Pandey is the new man in.

OUT! WOW! What a catch by the left arm-spinner, Pushpakumara! He has taken an absolute blinder. The question here is was this shot needed from Sharma? Fernando bowls it on a length outside off, Sharma gets down on one knee and goes for the scoop but does not generate enough power to get it over short fine leg. Malinda there leaps full stretch and takes it brilliantly. The umpires go upstairs to check the front foot and replays show that it is very, very close but Rohit has been given out. A big wicket for the hosts. The man in form has to depart. Game on!
Back of a length on off, Sharma punches it to the man at covers.
Length ball on middle, jags back into the batsman. Kohli works it around the corner for a run.
Bouncer to end the over. Sharma does well to evade it.
A touch ahead of a length outside off, Kohli plays it with an angled bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Kohli eases it to mid off.
Just short of  a length on off, Kohli stands tall and punches it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for two. That was hit on the up, just shows the form this man is in.
Good length outside off, Kohli lets it be.
Slower ball on the stumps, Sharma flicks it on the leg side for a run.

In the air... but safe! Shorter outside off, Sharma tries to pull but gets a top edge and it goes towards third man but lands in no man's land. Malinga at third man hares after the ball but could not reach. The batsmen take a run.

Tremendous effort from Pushpakumara! Again Fernando angles it on the pads, Sharma flicks it fine down the leg side. The fielder runs to his right and makes a great diving stop and saves two for his team. This is the kind of effort the Lankans need to put to defend this total.
Fuller in length angling away from the batsman. Rohit shoulders his arms to it.
Bowls it on middle, Kohli flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Kohli mistimes his drive through cover-point for a couple.
Lands it on a length on middle, Kohli defends it solidly.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side, Kohli misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.

BEAUTY! Good length on off, straightens and bounces a touch. Rohit feels for it but gets beaten. Dickwella behind the stumps goes up in an appeal and is the only one doing so. Umpire, Joel Wilson stays put.
Virat Kohli steps out next, replacing Rahane!

OUT! Malinga strikes! Not a good return for Rahane. This is another occasion where Rahane has got out to a short ball. Malinga bangs it in, Ajinkya goes for the pull but gets a top edge which goes down to fine leg. Munaweera stationed there sets himself under it and takes it on the third attempt. He almost dropped that but does well to hang on to it as he kept his eyes on the ball. An early wicket for Sri Lanka, just what they needed.
Slower one on middle, Sharma reads it well and tucks it behind square leg for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Rahane drives it towards mid off for a run.
Shorter and outside off, Rahane's eyes lit up and he goes for the cut but gets beaten. 7 dot balls in a row for Malinga.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
FOUR! Gift for Rohit! Full and swinging down the leg side. Sharma flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Bowls it on the pads, Sharma clips it through square leg for a couple.
Shortish length outside off, Sharma tries to force it through the off side but gets beaten.
Length outside off, Rahane guides it down to third man for a run.

Shorter in length on middle, Sharma tucks it towards square leg and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Rohit has made his ground. He was out in a similar manner in the first ODI as his bat got stuck in the ground. He has to be careful now.
Fuller in length around off, swinging away. Rahane works it to mid-wicket. A maiden for Malinga.
Trying to fox the batsman with the slower one but Rahane does well to block it.
A tad shorter on middle, Rahane flicks it towards mid-wicket for no runs.
Length ball around off, Rahane defends it towards point.
Hits the good length area on off, Rahane defends it off the front foot.
Malinga gets good shape away from the batsman. Lands it on a length around off, Rahane lunges forward in defense but gets beaten.
Started to find the middle, Rahane. Fernando bowls it just short of a length outside off, Rahane pushes it towards point where the fielder fumbles and they take a run.
Back of a length on off, Sharma taps it in front of covers and runs through for a single.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Sharma lets it be.
Length ball outside off, Rahane guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Gets swing into the batsman. Lands it on a length on off, Rahane tries to cut but gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls on the off side.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl with the second new ball. Just a slip in place for him...
Angles it onto the pads, Rahane flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.

NOT OUT! Sri Lanka have lost their only review in the first over. It was very close, could have gone either way. Fuller in length on middle, Rahane tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. The Sri Lankan players appeal and after thinking for quite a while the umpire shakes his head. After a chat with his teammates, Tharanga opts to review. Replays show that the impact is in line but it would have clipped the leg stump. The umpire's call stays. Ajinkya Rahane survives.
Sri Lanka have taken a review for lbw against Ajinkya Rahane. Looks mighty, mighty close.
Good length on off, Sharma defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on middle, Sharma tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length on off, Rohit defends it off the front foot.

Runs straightaway. The kind of form he is in, he won't be missing out there. Malinga bowls it shorter outside off, seeing the width on offer, Rohit punches it through cover-point for a brace. The outfield here is not that fast so the ball does not reach the fence and hence the fielder pulls it back.
We're ready to get underway for the chase. Rohit Sharma and Ajinkya Rahane will open the batting for India. Lasith Malinga will bowl the first over of this innings. He has two slips in place.
